land_pattern.package: THT right-angle RJ45, 10 signal pins (2 staggered rows of 5) + 4 LED pins + 2 board-lock holes + 2 mounting holes
land_pattern.notes: From the page-2 'Mounting Pattern (Component Side View)' drawing. Signal pins: 10 x dia 0.89 holes in two staggered rows - even row 10,8,6,4,2 left-to-right and odd row 9,7,5,3,1 left-to-right, 2.54 mm pitch within each row; the two rows are offset 0.64 mm either side of the package centreline (1.27 mm stagger, odd row to the right of centre). LED pins: 4 x dia 1.02 holes (14,13 left pair; 12,11 right pair) on a separate row above the signal rows. Mechanical: 2 x dia 3.25 holes and 2 x dia 1.63 holes. Printed pattern dimensions: 16.10 and 13.25 and 11.43 and 15.49 and 2.54 horizontal; 10.92 and 8.89 and 4.08 and 3.05 and 2.54 vertical, all referenced to the horizontal centreline through the two dia 3.25 holes. Drawing tolerance .xx +/-0.25, dimensions in mm. NOTE pad_count 14 counts electrical pins only; a KiCad footprint will normally add the 2 dia 1.63 board-lock/shield pads and 2 dia 3.25 unplated holes.
